Path of Building files of five of the 3.29 test builds in pbt-conformance (`builds/3.29/<name>/pob.xml` at commit 83cfc52), chosen to cover what changes the files a call reads:

- 01: level 1, no gems or items
- 05: gems and items on the standard tree
- 63: the ruthless tree
- 67: an item of a base the dataset does not have
- 70: a transfigured gem and a Relic, which item reading does not take
